title: ai_prompt_compressor plugin config
description: The `config` object of an enabled `ai_prompt_compressor` plugin, generated from ferrum-edge/ferrum-edge openapi.yaml at v0.9.21 (f9915358c8032214f4034a17c28cdf72d14006c3), component AiPromptCompressorConfig and every component it references. Do not edit: run ci/plugin_config_schemas.py. This is Edge's own configuration schema, governed by Edge's support policy (docs/versioning.md); the plugin catalog records when Edge requires it.

AiPromptCompressorConfig.description: Plugin: ai_prompt_compressor — Shortens LLM prompt text to reduce token usage, cost, and latency using a bounded model-free statistical (extractive) filter. Rewrites messages[].content (per role) and the legacy top-level prompt for admitted OpenAI Chat Completions or Text Completions representations, and — as fixed-family opt-ins — OpenAI Responses instructions/input message text and Anthropic Messages system/messages[].content text blocks. Code blocks, inline code, URLs, Unicode numbers, and common identifiers are preserved verbatim; negations, restrictive connectives (unless, except, only) and the word after them, plus conditions, obligations, quantifiers, and spelled-out numbers, are always kept. Configured preserve markers use a bounded representation-preserving fallback whenever statistical compression is skipped, and the final hook refuses (400) an admitted final representation — including the decoded view of a content-coded body — that still carries a marker in a string value. Successful compression rewrites reserialize the complete JSON body. No model files, network calls, or external services are used.

compress_roles.description: Message roles whose content is compressed (case-insensitive; at most 32 entries of at most 64 characters). Defaults to user only so system instructions are preserved; add 'system'/'assistant'/'tool' to compress those too. When 'user' is included, the legacy top-level `prompt` field (and a string Responses `input`) is also compressed. 'system' covers the Anthropic top-level system prompt; 'system' or 'developer' covers Responses `instructions`.

target_ratio.description: Fraction of word-tokens to keep. 0.5 targets ~50% reduction; 0.3 is more aggressive. Must be between 0 and 1 (exclusive).

min_content_tokens.description: Estimated-token floor per content string. Content below this is passed through unchanged so short prompts are not mangled. Token counts are estimated (~4 characters per token); no model tokenizer is embedded. A mathematically integral value is accepted however it is spelled (200 and 200.0 alike).

max_scan_bytes.description: A mathematically integral value is accepted however it is spelled. Skip statistical compression when the request body exceeds this size. Configured preserve-marker sanitation remains active up to the immutable 1048576-byte hard body/output maximum and fails closed above it. Eligible prompt text is additionally capped at 524288 bytes, 32768 combined whitespace/tokenizer/marker work units, 256 rewritable fields, and 1024 preserve markers per body. A transformed body is staged beside request metadata for wire-path reuse only when it is at most 65536 bytes.

preserve_tag.description: Optional marker name. Text wrapped in <TAG>...</TAG> in JSON string values is copied through verbatim (the markers themselves are stripped), letting operators protect must-keep spans. Preserve-marker sanitation applies only to string values: object member-name bytes are preserved and names are never sanitized, including marker-shaped or escaped content. Nested spans are flattened while preserving their text; unmatched and JSON-escaped markers in values are stripped deterministically from every admitted request family even when statistical compression is skipped. Name may contain at most 64 ASCII letters, digits, '-', and '_'.

request_family.description: Request-family gate. 'auto' requires a body shape matching the standard endpoint path suffix (/chat/completions or /completions). A fixed family is an explicit opt-in for compatible custom endpoint paths; malformed, provider-native, or ambiguous body shapes pass through unchanged. 'responses' admits OpenAI Responses bodies (string or array `input`; message items' input_text/output_text parts; `instructions`) and 'anthropic_messages' admits Anthropic Messages bodies (`messages` plus optional top-level `system`; text blocks only); neither is ever admitted by 'auto'. Fixed 'text_completions' requires 'user' in compress_roles (after trimming and case normalization).

target_max_tokens.description: Optional aggregate estimated-token budget for all eligible prompt text in one request. Requests within it are not statistically compressed; larger requests keep a per-request word ratio of target_max_tokens / eligible_tokens, never more aggressive than target_ratio. Best effort: protected spans, the target_ratio floor, and the word-versus-token approximation can leave a request above the budget, which is then forwarded rather than refused. A mathematically integral value is accepted however it is spelled.

mode.description: 'enforce' forwards compressed prompts. 'observe' runs the same bounded pipeline, records would-be savings under ai_prompt_compressor.observed_* metadata, and forwards the original prompt text; configured preserve markers are still removed and still fail closed.

sample_rate.description: Fraction of requests eligible for statistical compression (or observation), decided deterministically per request and instance. Unsampled requests are forwarded uncompressed with ai_prompt_compressor.instances.<id>.skipped=not_sampled; preserve-marker sanitation applies to every request.
